name: Cable Fly
common_faults: too much weight causing excessive elbow bend
shoulder internal rotation at end ROM
losing the arc and turning it into a press

substitutions.note: compound version; adds tricep and front delt
wider ROM than barbell; adds pressing muscles

contraindications: shoulder impingement provoked by adduction across midline
resistance_profile: constant cable tension provides resistance throughout the arc, unlike dumbbells (which peak at the bottom)

provenance.notes: Cable provides constant tension through ROM unlike dumbbell fly. Isolation exercise with limited systemic demand. Adjust cable height to target different pec regions.
